scope: Actual wizard submit/helpers and list delete callbacks, synthetic auth/fetch/FormData/router/clock/state. No project creation, logo upload, deletion or paid AI call.
results: wizard never enters automatic generation for bad creation, ownership, structure or uncertain network/body replies
failed, malformed or unassociated logo upload never triggers structure or generation and keeps the project for recovery
successful wizard with and without logo verifies stored structure before entering automatic generation
retry resumes the confirmed draft and never consumes another project-creation allowance
retry observes an already saved structure or an in-flight operation without reissuing generation
quota/login/daily-limit denials preserve the appropriate UI without automatic generation
each wizard request keeps its body deadline and double activation never duplicates a write
unmounted wizard stops after its current request without creating subsequent structure or navigation
project deletion needs the explicit successful server acknowledgment and retains the list on uncertainty
confirmed deletion refreshes the list and declined confirmation never issues a request
deletion body deadline and shared lock prevent duplicate or hanging deletions
unknown creation outcome prevents another project creation until the user checks the list and resets explicitly
